context.user-input: an order opened over an existing D-hierarchy
filled by the Regente before dispatch

instruction.user-input: hear this order, classify it, and emit the dispatch manifest

define-symbol.user-input: feature — the major concept; fragments into D2 and is never worked directly
concept — the cluster of D1 that fills one D3; owns its file and acts as checkpoint
task — atomic, the unit of work and the unit of resume

reference.needs: where the D3/D2/D1 breakdown already lives — this order reads it, never re-derives it

do-not.user-input: fragment again what a previous command already fragmented

template.name: germinate
template.means: Walks every aspect of a situation as seeds and grows the path to the goal as a tree: roots the problem, trunk the ordered effort, branches the resources it leans on, limits what is out of reach, locks what no step may bend, fruit the state that ends the work. Closes on an assumption that can be knocked down in one line.

iterate.user-input: the D3 this order opens, stated as the problem it closes rather than as the thing to build

problem.user-input: the D3 this order opens, stated as the problem it closes rather than as the thing to build

instruction.user-input: the D2 concepts that fill this D3, in dependency order — one line each, no D1 detail here

reference.user-input: a D1 already written, named by id and file — repeat once per task this order consumes

restriction.user-input: the D2 and D3 this order does not touch, and the guarantees the result must not break

constraint.user-input: what no D1 may bend, whatever else moves in the tree

never.user-input: no self-attested gate, and no acceptance criterion rewritten so the work passes

target.user-input: the state that closes this D3 — observable by someone who did not do the work

ready.user-input: each fruit stated as an observable condition, not as an intention

assumption.user-input: what is taken as given about the existing breakdown and was not checked against the repo

question.user-input: knock this down in one line and the tree becomes a new version

validate.user-input: the criterion the finished D3 is validated against

go.user-input: continue from there, never from the top of the tree
